rubric.role_summary: Senior agronomist translating regenerative arable-farming expertise into farmer-facing digital recommendations and assessments, while reviewing agronomic data and testing product outputs against farm realities.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior agronomist translating regenerative arable-farming expertise into farmer-facing digital recommendations and assessments, while reviewing agronomic data and testing product outputs against farm realities.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years in farm management, agronomic advisory, farm business consultancy, or a comparable role carrying responsibility for real decisions on real farms.
- A solid academic background in agronomy, agricultural sciences, or a related discipline, OR a strong practical track record in its place.
- Strong hands-on experience in open-field arable systems in temperate Europe.
- Experience with regenerative or sustainable arable farming.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience of the German market.
- Living in Berlin or being able to attend the Berlin office regularly is advantageous, not mandatory.
- Deep understanding of regenerative arable farming, including soil health, nutrient management, crop rotations, cover crops, tillage, and reduced-input systems.
- Hands-on farm economics experience building an investment case alongside a farmer.
- Experience using farm software.
- Ability to analyze spreadsheets or performance figures and identify faulty logic.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: European Union (remote). This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
